# Assembly / modelling notes
* STEP part files carry no assembly positions, so the layout is rebuilt from the measurement table and the circle
  centres inside `track__updated.step` (sprocket axle at the origin, rollers at x = +/-153 mm, 103.5 mm lower).
* Visual meshes in `tracked_robot_description/meshes/visual` are generated by `scripts/generate_meshes.py`
  (binary STL, metres). To use real CAD: export decimated STL (<~30k triangles) with the same file name, same origin
  (axle centre; spin axis = Y; belt profile in X-Z, width along Y), and the same scale (metres).
* Structure chain (so nothing floats): chassis wall -> 19 mm axle stub -> track-frame plate -> wheel hub (touches the plate) -> wheel.
* Tread animation: `TrackAnimator` plugin (tracked_robot_gz_plugins) moves the `<side>_lug_<i>` visuals along the belt path using the
  front-roller joint angle (belt travel = 0.0845 m x angle). Visual only; collision/physics are unchanged. The belt link is kept
  un-merged via `preserveFixedJoint` so the lug visuals keep their names.
* Real outstanding unknowns: chassis box height (23 cm assumed; STEP 25.5 cm), mass split, motor gearing, front/back track offsets.
